zh_TW: 圖鑑 (怪物 / 塔 / 魔法)
塔 防 要 塞
快捷列  (戰鬥底欄擺邊六座塔)
撳一個槽,再撳一座塔就放入去。撳兩個槽 = 對調。再撳同一座塔 = 清空。
en: Tap a slot then a tower to assign it. Tap two slots to swap them. Tap the same tower again to clear.

zh_TW: 詛咒塔已重造,已退還 {n} 魔晶
佢哋一路行一路回血,仲會互相治療 —— 打得快過佢哋回血先清得走
en: They regenerate as they walk and heal each other — out-damage the healing or they never go down

zh_TW: 殺死咗會返生,打散咗會分裂 —— 逐隻逐隻打,追唔到佢哋嘅數量
en: The dead get back up and the big ones split — killing them one at a time will never keep up

zh_TW: 佢哋一樣會分裂,但今次每一隻都有護甲同魔抗 —— 範圍傷害仲要打得穿佢哋先有用
en: They still split, but now every body has armour and resistance — your splash has to punch through as well

zh_TW: 有怪物攻入基地 — 第 {n} 關
擊敗 boss 可獲得更多!
en: Defeat the boss to earn more!

zh_TW: 戰鬥太短,今次冇魔晶獎勵
en: Battle too short — no Crystals this time

zh_TW: 已擊傷首領 {pct}% — 擊敗佢可獲得更多!
en: Boss worn down {pct}% — finish it for more!

zh_TW: 戰鬥進度 {pct}% (失敗上限 {cap} 魔晶)
確定要重置? 再按一次
最高通關: 第 {n} 關     魔晶: {c}
美術畫廊 — 辨識度審查
左右滑動或用 ‹ › 翻頁 · 於戰鬥中見過的怪物才會解鎖
en: Swipe or tap ‹ › to turn pages · Only creatures met in battle are revealed
Fight it to unlock this entry

zh_TW: 拖出去放塔,或者撳一下再撳地圖
en: Drag out to place, or tap then tap the map

zh_TW: 箭塔以穩定節奏鎖定射程圈內最近的單一敵人放箭,是可靠的基礎輸出。強化暴擊與雙重射擊後,單體爆發顯著提升。
en: The Arrow Tower looses shafts at a steady rhythm, always picking the nearest enemy inside its ring — dependable, unglamorous damage. Invest in crits and double shots and its single-target burst climbs sharply.

zh_TW: 拋物線範圍爆炸,攻速慢
加農砲台拋射砲彈,落點造成範圍爆炸傷害,適合清理成群小怪。攻速較慢,講求預判落點;破甲與擊退進一步強化控場。
en: The Cannon Battery lobs shells that detonate where they land, shredding tight packs of small enemies. It reloads slowly, so placement and lead matter; armor pierce and knockback turn it into a control piece.

zh_TW: 雷電塔射出閃電,在鄰近敵人之間連鎖跳躍,每跳一次傷害衰減。密集路段可同時削弱多個目標;提升連鎖數與降低衰減後覆蓋更廣。
en: The Thunder Spire throws a bolt that leaps from body to body, weakening with every hop. On a crowded stretch of road it grinds down several enemies at once; more chains and less falloff widen its reach.

zh_TW: 火球塔直射火焰,命中後附加持續燃燒傷害,對高血量目標尤其有效。燃燒可延長時間;爆燃機率觸發時瞬間引爆剩餘燃燒。
en: The Fireball Tower hurls flame straight ahead and leaves the target burning — brutal against anything with a deep health pool. Burns can be stretched longer, and a detonation roll blows the remaining burn all at once.

zh_TW: 冰霜塔攻擊附帶減速,令敵人更久停留在火網內;命中有機率完全冰凍目標。減速幅度與冰凍率是它的控場核心。
en: Every frost shard slows what it touches, holding enemies inside your kill zone far longer; some hits freeze the target outright. Slow power and freeze chance are the heart of its control.

zh_TW: 疊層毒,無視護甲,並使目標重傷
en: Stacking armor-ignoring poison that cripples healing

zh_TW: 毒液塔疊加毒層造成持續傷害,並無視敵人護甲;毒層越高傷害越猛。中毒的目標同時陷入重傷,所受的一切治療大幅降低 —— 這是對抗巫教族群療的正面解答。敵人死亡時毒素向周圍擴散,引發連環中毒。
en: The Venom Tower layers poison stacks that eat through health regardless of armor — the deeper the stack, the faster it kills. Anything poisoned is also crippled: every point of healing it receives is cut down, which is the direct answer to a Cultist mass heal. When a poisoned enemy dies the toxin bursts outward and infects its neighbours.

zh_TW: 超遠程高傷,優先點名巫師與高血目標
en: Extreme range; picks off casters, then the toughest

zh_TW: 狙擊塔擁有全場最遠射程,並且優先狙擊後排的支援型單位 —— 巫師與大祭司在牠眼中永遠排第一,其次才是高血量目標。血量低於處決線可被即殺;貫穿讓子彈洞穿多個目標。
en: The Sniper Nest reaches further than anything else on the field and always looks for a support caster first — a Cultist or a High Priest outranks even the healthiest target. Anything below the execute threshold dies instantly, and pierce sends the round through the rank behind it.
Fire rate climbs while locked on

zh_TW: 機槍塔持續鎖定同一目標時攻速不斷攀升,越打越快;切換目標會重置熱度。是對付單一厚血敵人的利器。
en: Hold the Gatling Tower on one target and its barrels spin ever faster — the longer it fires, the harder it hits. Switching targets dumps all that heat, so it excels against a single armored bruiser.

zh_TW: 迫擊砲超遠程曲射,對落點大範圍轟炸,但有最小射程死角。彈片分裂可波及更多敵人;燒灼地面造成殘留傷害。
en: The Siege Mortar arcs shells across almost the whole map and saturates the impact zone — but it cannot hit anything standing too close. Shrapnel widens the spread; scorched ground keeps burning after the blast.

zh_TW: 持續光束,鎖定愈久愈痛
en: A sustained beam that keeps ramping

zh_TW: 光束塔發射持續光束,鎖定同一目標越久傷害越高。融甲蝕魔同時削去目標的護甲與魔抗,讓全隊的物理與魔法輸出一起變利;雙光束可同時照射兩個目標。
en: The Beam Tower pours an unbroken lance of light into its target, and the damage climbs the longer it holds. Melt Armor & Ward strips protection AND magic resistance together, sharpening the whole team's physical and magical output at once; a twin beam splits the assault across two enemies.

zh_TW: 緩速力場塔本身不造成傷害,以光環大幅減速範圍內所有敵人;脆弱效果令其受到額外傷害。可強化為對 boss 同樣有效。
en: The Slowing Field deals no damage of its own; instead its aura drags every enemy inside it to a crawl and leaves them vulnerable to extra damage. Upgraded far enough, it bites into bosses just as hard.

zh_TW: 鍊金塔不攻擊,定期自動產出金幣,是經濟核心。範圍內擊殺可獲得額外賞金,開場更提供一筆啟動資金。
en: The Alchemy Tower never fires a shot — it simply turns time into gold, and it is the backbone of your economy. Kills inside its circle pay a bounty, and it hands you a lump of starting capital the moment the wave begins.
Sends soldiers to block the road

zh_TW: 兵營塔派出士兵駐守路面,以肉身阻擋敵人前進並近身纏鬥;士兵陣亡後定期重生。增兵與護甲讓防線更穩固。
en: The Barracks Tower posts soldiers on the road itself, stopping the advance with their bodies and tying enemies up in melee; the fallen are replaced on a timer. More bodies and heavier armor make the wall hold.

zh_TW: 來回穿透打沿途所有怪
迴旋鏢塔擲出迴旋鏢,去程與回程都會貫穿路徑上所有敵人。回程可附加額外傷害;多鏢齊發覆蓋更廣路段。
en: The Boomerang Tower throws a blade that cuts through every enemy on its way out and again on its way home. The return pass can be sharpened further, and extra blades blanket a longer stretch of road.

zh_TW: 對鄰近路段持續傷害(飛行無效)
en: Constant damage to nearby road (not fliers)

zh_TW: 荊棘塔對鄰近路段持續造成傷害,但對飛行敵人無效;流血可疊加。對重型敵人有額外加成,是近戰路段的穩定消耗。
en: The Bramble Tower rips at anything walking the road beside it — but thorns cannot reach what flies. Bleed stacks pile up, and heavy enemies take extra punishment, making it a steady grinder on close-quarters lanes.

zh_TW: 超遠程追蹤導彈,專剋 boss 同大型
導彈塔以超遠射程追蹤鎖定,對 boss 與大型單位造成額外傷害,並優先點名後排的支援型單位。齊射可同時發射多枚導彈;爆炸範圍能一次清掉聚在一起的敵人。
en: The Missile Tower tracks its target across the longest reach on the board, hits bosses and heavy units far harder than anything else, and prioritises back-rank support casters. A salvo puts several warheads in the air at once, and the blast clears anything bunched around the impact.

zh_TW: 常駐詛咒光環:圈內敵人受傷加深、死亡多掉金
en: Hex aura: more damage taken, more gold dropped

zh_TW: 詛咒塔不攻擊,以常駐光環籠罩路段:圈內敵人(含 boss)受到的傷害大幅加深,走出光環後仍殘留片刻。被詛咒者陣亡時額外掉金,所以它同時是放大器與經濟塔 —— 但必須擺在已有輸出塔的位置。多座光環的放大不疊加(取最高)。
en: The Curse Tower never attacks. It drapes a standing hex over a stretch of road: everything inside it — bosses included — takes markedly more damage, and the mark lingers for a moment after they walk out. Cursed enemies drop extra gold when they die, so it is amplifier and economy in one — but only where damage towers already stand. Overlapping auras do not stack; the strongest one wins.

zh_TW: 全場攻速光環,兼具傷害與加持
en: A field-wide fire-rate aura, plus damage

zh_TW: 聖光塔造成聖屬傷害,並以光環提升場上每一座友方塔的攻速 —— 沒有範圍限制,一座就照亮全場。聖光強度讓光環同時附帶攻擊力加成。多座聖光塔的光環會遞減疊加,所以第二座仍然有用,第五座則幾乎沒有。淨化可移除敵人增益。
en: The Radiance Tower burns with holy damage while its aura quickens every friendly tower on the board — no radius, no falloff, one tower lights the whole field. Radiant Might adds an attack bonus on top of the speed. Extra Radiance Towers stack with diminishing returns, so a second one is worth building and a fifth is not. Purify strips buffs off the enemy.

zh_TW: 磁力塔週期性釋放脈衝,將範圍內敵人擊退拉回,延緩其推進;擊退後附帶減速。對重型敵人亦有一定效果。
en: The Magnet Tower fires a pulse on a cycle, dragging everything in range backwards and stalling the advance; the shove leaves them slowed. Even heavy units feel some of the pull.

zh_TW: 傳送塔有機率將敵人傳送回後方路段,大幅拖延其行程;傳送後可附帶暈眩。對同一目標的傳送次數設有上限。
en: The Warp Tower may snatch an enemy and drop it back down the road, wiping out much of its progress; the arrival can leave it stunned. Any single target can only be sent back so many times.
Massive damage at a chosen point

zh_TW: 在指定位置召喚隕石,對大範圍造成瞬間傷害,最適合砸向密集的敵群。
en: Calls a burning rock down on a spot you choose, flattening a wide circle in an instant — best dropped straight onto a packed crowd.
Bolts strike at random across the field

zh_TW: 全場隨機落下多道閃電,每道造成單體傷害;落雷數越多,清場越快。
en: Bolts hammer down all over the map, each one striking a single enemy; the more bolts fall, the faster the field clears.
Freezes every enemy on the map

zh_TW: 凍結全場敵人一段時間,解凍後仍殘留減速,是危急時的保命大招。
en: Locks every enemy in ice for a spell, and they stay sluggish after the thaw — the button you press when the line is about to break.

zh_TW: 指定區域持續毒傷,並重創其回復
en: Lingering poison that shuts down healing

zh_TW: 在指定區域釋放毒瘴,持續對範圍內敵人造成每秒毒傷,同時大幅削弱他們所受的一切治療。丟在巫教族的隊伍上,群療就再也補不回來。
en: Releases a cloud of venom over the chosen ground, eating away at everything inside it and gutting any healing they receive. Dropped on a Cultist pack, the mass heal stops keeping up.

zh_TW: 在路面召喚民兵堵路,以肉身拖住敵人推進的節奏。
en: Calls up militia in the middle of the road to buy you time with their bodies.

zh_TW: 立即獲得一筆金幣,持續期間擊殺敵人還可額外生財。
en: Hands you a purse of gold on the spot, and for a while afterwards every kill pays a little extra.

zh_TW: 扭曲時間,令全場敵人大幅減速一段時間。
en: Bends time around the battlefield, dragging every enemy to a crawl for a while.

zh_TW: 鼓舞全軍,短時間內所有塔的攻速一同提升。
en: A roar down the line — for a short burst every tower you own fires noticeably faster.

zh_TW: 為基地張開結界,可抵擋數次入侵,並附帶反傷。
en: Raises a ward over the keep that swallows a few breaches outright, and burns whatever runs into it.
Blows enemies back down the road

zh_TW: 沿路捲起龍捲風,將途經的敵人一併推回後方。
en: Tears a whirlwind along the road, hurling everything it passes back the way it came.
% max-HP damage to all ground enemies

zh_TW: 地震撼動全場,對地面敵人造成當前生命值百分比傷害,對 boss 造成固定重傷。
en: The ground heaves across the whole map, tearing a percentage of health from every enemy on foot and landing a heavy fixed blow on the boss.
Sets a stretch of road ablaze

zh_TW: 在指定路段生成火牆,對經過的敵人持續灼燒。
en: Raises a curtain of fire across the road; anything that walks through it keeps burning.

zh_TW: 點選單一目標巨大傷害,專誅支援
en: Colossal damage to one target, lethal to casters

zh_TW: 對單一目標降下天雷造成巨大傷害,對 boss 有額外加成,而對支援型單位(巫師、大祭司)的傷害更是加倍有餘 —— 後排的治療者是它真正的獵物。
en: Calls down a pillar of judgement on one chosen enemy — devastating on anything, deeper still into a boss, and outright lethal to a support caster. The healer at the back is what this spell is really for.

zh_TW: 指定範圍暈眩,並關閉光環
en: Stuns an area and silences auras

zh_TW: 在指定範圍釋放磁暴,暈眩其中所有敵人。暈眩期間敵人的光環類技能 —— 治療與加速 —— 完全失效,所以這是把巫教族的支援網一次拔掉的開關。
en: Detonates a magnetic storm over the target zone, leaving everything inside it stunned. A stunned enemy's auras — healing and haste alike — stop working entirely, so this is the switch that takes a Cultist support web offline all at once.
Pins enemies at a chosen point

zh_TW: 在指定位置製造黑洞,吸住並持續傷害範圍內的敵人。
en: Tears open a singularity that holds enemies in place and grinds them down while it lasts.

zh_TW: 普通雜兵,無特殊能力,慣以數量取勝。
en: Rank-and-file rabble with no special tricks — they win by sheer numbers.

zh_TW: 首領技:定期召喚小哥布林增援。
en: Boss skill: summons goblin reinforcements at regular intervals.

zh_TW: 移動極快的野獸,血量偏低但難以攔截。
en: Fast-moving beasts — thin-skinned, but very hard to pin down.

zh_TW: 暴怒:受擊後短暫狂暴,移速大增。
en: Frenzy: after taking a hit it goes berserk and its speed spikes.

zh_TW: 陣亡後有機會原地復活一次;略帶魔抗。
en: May claw its way back up once after falling; carries some magic resistance.

zh_TW: 亡靈光環:周圍骷髏最多可復活兩次,第二次只回復一半生命。
en: Undead Aura: nearby skeletons rise up to twice, the second time at half health.

zh_TW: 高護甲重甲兵,大幅減免物理傷害,移動緩慢。
en: Heavily armored and slow, shrugging off most physical damage.

zh_TW: 石化:定期進入短暫無敵狀態。
en: Petrify: periodically turns to solid stone and becomes untouchable.

zh_TW: 週期虛化,虛化期間無法被鎖定;高魔抗。
en: Phases out on a cycle and cannot be targeted while it does; high magic resistance.

zh_TW: 疾影:虛化時移動速度更快。
en: Swiftshade: moves far faster while phased.

zh_TW: 飛行單位,無視地面陷阱與近戰堵路。
en: Airborne — ignores ground hazards and anything blocking the road.
Dive: periodically accelerates into a sudden lunge.

zh_TW: 持續自我回復生命,消耗戰極為棘手。
en: Regenerates constantly — a nightmare in a war of attrition.

zh_TW: 扎根:低血時定身詠唱回復,詠唱期間受到的傷害會抵銷回復量,暈眩可直接打斷。
en: Take Root: at low health it roots and channels a heal — damage dealt during the cast cancels it point for point, and a stun breaks it outright.

zh_TW: 硬殼:單次所受傷害有上限,懼怕持續傷害。
en: Hard Shell: caps the damage of any single hit — but it fears damage over time.

zh_TW: 堅甲反震:受到的傷害整體降低。
光環:持續治療並加速周圍同伴。
en: Aura: continuously heals and hastens everything around it.

zh_TW: 群療:定期治療全場敵人。
en: Mass Heal: periodically heals every enemy on the field.

zh_TW: 陣亡時分裂成兩隻較小的史萊姆。
en: Splits into two smaller slimes when killed.

zh_TW: 增殖:定期分裂出小史萊姆。
en: Proliferate: keeps spawning smaller slimes on a timer.

zh_TW: 巫教族靠治療與加速光環續命。以毒液塔的重傷或劇毒瘴氣削弱其回復,或以磁暴脈衝在暈眩期間直接關閉光環。狙擊塔與導彈塔會優先點名後排的巫師。
en: Cultists live on their healing and haste auras. Cut the healing with the Venom Tower's Mortal Wound or with Toxic Miasma, or switch the auras off outright by stunning them with an EMP Surge. Sniper Nests and Missile Towers pick the back-rank casters first.

zh_TW: 聖光塔已改為全場光環,「光環範圍」升級軸取消。已投入的魔晶 {n} 全數退回。
en: The Radiance Tower's aura is now field-wide, so the Aura Radius path no longer exists. All {n} crystals spent on it have been refunded.

zh_TW: 六條升級軸全部課滿 {max} 級才能進化(目前 {done}/{total})
en: All upgrade paths must reach level {max} first ({done}/{total} done)

zh_TW: 三條升級軸全部課滿 {max} 級才能進化(目前 {done}/{total})
en: All upgrade paths must reach level {max} first ({done}/{total} done)

zh_TW: 全部升級軸已滿。進化後基礎能力大幅躍升,並解鎖一個全新機制,升級軸重新開放。
en: Every path is maxed. Evolving lifts the base numbers far past this tier and unlocks a new mechanic; the upgrade paths reopen from zero.

zh_TW: 升級軸未課滿,未能進化
雙重射擊變三連;對同一目標連續命中會層層疊加傷害,換目標則歸零。
en: The double shot becomes a triple, and every consecutive hit on the same target stacks bonus damage — switching targets resets it.

zh_TW: 每第五支箭必定暴擊,並貫穿沿途所有敵人。
en: Every fifth arrow always crits and punches through everything in its line.

zh_TW: 每發砲彈在落點爆炸兩次,第二次範圍更大。
en: Every shell detonates twice on impact, the second blast wider than the first.

zh_TW: 破城彈:爆炸範圍內的敵人永久失去護甲,可疊加。
en: Breaching shot: everything caught in the blast permanently loses armor, and it stacks.

zh_TW: 被閃電擊中的敵人成為導體,下一次連鎖必定經過牠並額外增傷。
en: A struck enemy becomes a conductor: the next chain is guaranteed to route through it and hits harder for doing so.

zh_TW: 連鎖結束後在最後一個目標頭頂再降一道落雷,範圍傷害兼麻痺。
en: When the chain ends, a bolt falls on the last link — area damage and a guaranteed stun.

zh_TW: 燃燒中的敵人死亡時原地留下一灘餘燼,持續灼燒。
en: An enemy that dies while burning leaves a pool of embers behind it.

zh_TW: 引爆成功時,爆炸把燃燒狀態傳染給範圍內所有敵人。
en: A successful detonation spreads the burn to everything inside the blast.

zh_TW: 被減速的敵人累積凍傷層,凍結成立時一次過引爆為真實傷害。
en: Slowed enemies accumulate frostbite, and a freeze detonates every stack at once as true damage.

zh_TW: 射程內的地面永久結冰,經過的敵人自帶額外減速。
en: The ground inside its range freezes over for good — anything that walks it is slowed on top of everything else.

zh_TW: 毒層滿的敵人死亡時,把整疊毒層傳染給附近的敵人。
en: When an enemy dies at full stacks, the whole stack jumps to the nearest bodies.

zh_TW: 毒素崩解:每滿一定毒層,目標的生命上限永久下降。
en: Rot: every full load of stacks permanently eats into the target's maximum health.

zh_TW: 每次命中留下致命標記,標記越多下一發越痛,擊殺時清空。
en: Each hit leaves a killing mark; the more marks, the harder the next shot lands. A kill wipes them.

zh_TW: 處決線大幅提高,而且處決成功後下一發必定暴擊。
en: The execute threshold climbs sharply, and a successful execute guarantees a crit on the next shot.

zh_TW: 熱度滿的瞬間釋放一圈環形彈幕,然後熱度減半繼續。
en: The instant heat maxes out it sprays a ring of fire, then halves the heat and keeps going.

zh_TW: 換目標不再清空熱度,只減半;熱度同時提升散射機率。
en: Switching targets no longer dumps the heat, only halves it — and heat now drives the spread chance too.

zh_TW: 每次開火發射兩發彈道錯開的砲彈,覆蓋一整條線。
en: Each shot puts two shells in the air on offset arcs, covering a whole line.

zh_TW: 校射:連續轟同一片區域會層層提升範圍與傷害,換區則歸零。
en: Ranging: pounding the same patch stacks up both blast size and damage; move the impact and it resets.

zh_TW: 光束擊中後折射到附近另一個敵人身上。
en: The beam refracts off its target onto whatever stands nearest.

zh_TW: 蓄能滿後進入爆發模式,短時間內傷害倍增,然後重新蓄能。
en: Once fully charged it overloads: damage multiplies for a few seconds, then the charge starts again.

zh_TW: 場內敵人被持續拉向中心,飛行單位同樣受制。
en: Everything inside is dragged back toward the centre — flyers included.

zh_TW: 每隔一段時間,場內所有敵人完全定身一瞬。
en: At intervals the whole field simply stops for a moment.

zh_TW: 場上每多一座鍊金系塔,產金效率就提升(遞減疊加)。
en: Every other alchemy tower on the board raises this one's output, with diminishing returns.

zh_TW: 射程內的敵人死亡時有機會直接煉成一筆額外橫財。
en: An enemy dying in range may be transmuted outright into a windfall.

zh_TW: 陣型:士兵互相靠近時同時獲得額外護甲與傷害。
en: Formation: soldiers standing together gain armor and damage from each other.

zh_TW: 不屈:士兵陣亡時原地爆發,造成範圍傷害並擊退。
en: Undying: a fallen soldier detonates where it stood, damaging and throwing back everything around it.

zh_TW: 同時擲出兩把成夾角的迴旋鏢,交叉點的敵人吃兩次。
en: Throws two blades on crossing arcs — anything at the intersection takes both.

zh_TW: 迴旋鏢回程後有機會立即再擲出,不消耗攻速。
en: A returning blade may be flung straight back out at no cost to the fire rate.

zh_TW: 纏繞:每次觸發把範圍內最前的敵人短暫定身。
en: Ensnare: every trigger roots whichever enemy is furthest along the road.

zh_TW: 根系沿著道路蔓延,覆蓋範圍不再是一個圓而是一整段路。
en: The roots run along the road itself — the reach stops being a circle and becomes a stretch of path.

zh_TW: 追蹤鎖定:對同一目標連續命中,該目標受到的導彈傷害層層提升。
en: Lock-on: consecutive hits make the same target take more and more missile damage.

zh_TW: 每隔數次齊射改射一枚巨型彈頭,傷害與範圍暴增並必定擊退。
en: Every few salvos becomes one enormous warhead: far more damage, far wider blast, guaranteed knockback.

zh_TW: 恐懼:光環內的敵人會定期被嚇退一小段路。
en: Dread: enemies inside the ring are periodically driven back down the road.

zh_TW: 獻祭:光環內的死亡累積虛空能量,滿了就對全場引爆真實傷害。
en: Sacrifice: kills inside the aura charge the void, and a full charge detonates as true damage across the whole field.

zh_TW: 全場光環額外附帶暴擊率;本塔對支援型敵人造成額外傷害.
en: The field-wide aura also grants crit chance, and this tower hits support casters harder.

zh_TW: 復甦之光:定期為全場補回一名陣亡士兵,並清除敵人的加速狀態。
en: Rekindling: on a timer it restores a fallen soldier anywhere on the field and strips haste off every enemy.

zh_TW: 磁軌:被推撞的敵人互相碰撞,擠得越密傷害越高。
en: Railslam: shoved enemies collide with each other — the tighter the crowd, the more it hurts.

zh_TW: 極性反轉:每隔幾次脈衝改為吸引,把敵人拉成一團。
en: Polarity flip: every few pulses it pulls instead of pushes, packing the enemy into one heap.

zh_TW: 回溯:傳送成功時清除目標身上的所有增益。
en: Rewind: a successful warp strips every buff off the target.

zh_TW: 放逐:有機會把非 boss 敵人直接送回起點,次數有上限。
en: Banish: a chance to send a non-boss enemy all the way back to the start, up to a limit.

zh_TW: 主隕石之後跟著三顆小隕石落下。
en: Three smaller rocks follow the main impact down.

zh_TW: 著彈點留下一片熔岩地帶,持續灼燒經過的一切。
en: The impact leaves a lava field burning everything that crosses it.

zh_TW: 每一道閃電在落點小範圍濺射。
en: Every bolt splashes over a small area where it lands.

zh_TW: 被雷擊中的敵人在數秒內承受的所有傷害都被放大。
en: Anything struck takes amplified damage from every source for several seconds.

zh_TW: 凍結期間的敵人承受的傷害大幅提高。
en: Frozen enemies take substantially more damage.

zh_TW: 解凍後留下一片冰原,繼續拖慢走過的敵人。
en: The thaw leaves an ice field that keeps slowing whatever walks it.

zh_TW: 霧中的敵人護甲被持續腐蝕。
en: Armor corrodes away on anything standing in the fog.

zh_TW: 在霧中死亡的敵人會再生出一團小型毒雲。
en: An enemy that dies inside the cloud seeds a smaller one where it fell.

zh_TW: 召喚出來的單位帶著護盾,可擋下第一次致命傷。
en: The summoned come shielded and survive the first killing blow.

zh_TW: 陣亡時爆炸,並把剩餘時間分給其餘同袍。
en: One that falls explodes, and hands its remaining time to the others.

zh_TW: 除了即時金幣,一段時間內所有擊殺額外掉金。
en: On top of the lump sum, every kill for a while pays extra.

zh_TW: 效果期間敵人每被打中一次就掉一點金。
en: While it holds, enemies shed gold every time they are hit.

zh_TW: 減速期間敵人的技能節奏一併被拖慢,boss 也不例外。
en: Enemy ability timers drag as well as their feet — bosses included.

zh_TW: 施放瞬間,全場敵人退回數秒前的位置。
en: On cast, every enemy snaps back to where it stood seconds ago.

zh_TW: 除了攻速,全場塔同時獲得攻擊力加成。
en: Attack power rises alongside the fire rate, on every tower.

zh_TW: 期間所有塔的攻擊附帶真實傷害濺射。
en: While it lasts every tower's shots splash true damage.

zh_TW: 結界存在期間,基地附近的敵人持續受到傷害。
en: While the ward stands, anything near the keep is burned down.

zh_TW: 每擋下一名敵人就回復一層結界,直到上限。
en: Every enemy it blocks gives a charge back, up to a ceiling.

zh_TW: 龍捲風原地停留數秒,持續推回進入的敵人。
en: The funnel stays put for a few seconds, shoving back anything that enters.

zh_TW: 被吹飛的敵人落地時承受一筆按生命上限計算的真實傷害。
en: Whatever it throws takes true damage scaled to its own maximum health on landing.

zh_TW: 地面裂開,數秒內經過的地面單位被大幅拖慢。
en: The ground splits open and drags at every grounded unit that crosses it.

zh_TW: 地面單位被震暈,飛行單位被震落地面。
en: Grounded units are stunned outright, and flyers are shaken out of the air.

zh_TW: 火牆會沿著道路向前推進一段距離。
en: The wall advances along the road instead of standing still.

zh_TW: 每有敵人死在火牆裡,火牆就燒得更久。
en: Every enemy that dies in the flames makes them burn longer.

zh_TW: 對支援型單位(巫師、大祭司)的傷害再大幅提升。
en: Damage against support casters climbs sharply again.

zh_TW: 目標死亡時,溢出的傷害轉移到最近的另一個敵人身上。
en: When the target dies, the overkill jumps to whatever stands nearest.

zh_TW: 暈眩範圍與時間大幅延長,光環封鎖同步加長。
en: Both the radius and the duration of the silence climb sharply.

zh_TW: 範圍內敵人的增益全被清除,並且一段時間內無法再獲得。
en: Every buff inside is wiped, and nothing there can be buffed again for a while.

zh_TW: 吸力更強,被困住的敵人受到的傷害逐秒遞增。
en: It pulls harder, and damage on anything trapped climbs the longer it is held.

zh_TW: 結束時內爆,把整段時間累積的傷害再打一次。
en: On collapse it implodes, dealing a share of everything it absorbed all over again.

zh_TW: 遊戲上次冇正常收場。下面係閃退之前嘅記錄,撳「複製」就可以整段貼出嚟報告。你嘅進度已經儲存,唔會有嘢唔見咗。
en: The game did not shut down normally last time. Below is what it was doing just before. Tap Copy to paste the whole report into a bug report. Your progress was saved and nothing was lost.

zh_TW: 今次冇夠採樣點畫趨勢(閃退發生喺開場三十秒內)。
en: Not enough samples to plot a trend — the crash happened within the first 30 seconds.

zh_TW: 刻度橫跨三個階級:底色三段分別係第一/二/三階課滿嘅範圍,深色界線就係進化門檻。
en: The scale spans all three tiers: the three shaded bands are what tier I, II and III reach fully upgraded, and the dark ticks are the evolution thresholds.

zh_TW: 未解鎖 —— 喺商店買咗先睇得到數值
en: Not unlocked — buy it in the shop to see its numbers
Tap to open its upgrade page
